Author: Darion
Name: Dippin' Dots
Punchline: Price dots on retainer and inventory slots while you sell.
Description: While the retainer sell list is open, draws a small dot in the bottom-left corner of each retainer bag and Expanded inventory slot, colored by the item's 7-day median sale price x stack size on your home world (Universalis). A hollow ring means the price data is thin or inconsistent. Settings: /dots config, or the cog in the plugin installer.
